none: PAS YORYM-8A1AD1: Roman coin: radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman radiate of Carausius, dating to the period AD 286-293 (Reece period 14). PROVIDE AVG reverse type depicting Providentia standing left with globe and transverse sceptre. C mint, S (P?) // C. Cf. RIC V, p. 495, no. 373var. This coin has an obverse legend, IMP C CARAVSIVS AVG, not recorded for type in RIC. There is one other coin of this type in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC.…
